user_input: My Galaxy Buds3 Pro left earbud won't connect. Is this a known issue, and has the same problem been resolved for another customer? What fixed it?

Yes. Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro work with iPhones as normal Bluetooth earbuds. Some features, such as auto switch between Samsung devices and full app controls, work best with Samsung Galaxy phones.', '[TCK-1011] Defective Galaxy S25 replaced, replacement also defective
Customer issue: Galaxy S25 had a faulty speaker. A replacement was sent, but the replacement also had a display flicker. Resolution: As per RR-005, a product can be replaced only once, and if the replacement is also defective the customer gets a full refund. Full refund issued by UPI within 2 business days, as per RR-004. Status: Resolved.', '[KI-002] AirPods Pro 2: one earbud not charging in the case
Some customers report that one AirPods Pro 2 earbud does not charge in the case. The usual cause is dirt on the charging contacts. Fix: clean the earbud and case contacts gently with a dry cotton swab and check that the earbud sits fully in the case. If it still does not charge, raise an Apple warranty claim.']
response: Yes. This is a known issue. Another customer had the same problem after switching phones; resetting the earbuds and pairing them again as a new device fixed it. Put both earbuds in the case, close the lid for 10 seconds, then reset them in the Galaxy Wearable app or hold both touchpads for 7 seconds before pairing again.
reference: Yes, it's a known issue, usually after pairing with a new phone. A previous customer had the same problem after switching phones (TCK-1001): the earbuds were still paired with the old phone, and resetting and pairing again as a new device fixed it. ['[RR-005] Replacement vs refund rules
A replacement is given for the same model and colour. If the same model is out of stock, the customer can choose a refund or a different colour of the same model. Price differences are not adjusted. user_input: A prepaid order has already shipped and the customer wants to cancel it. What can they do, and how is the refund handled?
retrieved_contexts:
['[OG-001] How to cancel an order
An order can be cancelled from the Orders page any time before it is shipped. Prepaid orders are refunded as per policy RR-004. Once an order is shipped, it cannot be cancelled. The customer can refuse the delivery instead, and the refund is processed as per policy SH-005.', '[SH-005] Failed delivery attempts
The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. If all 3 attempts fail, or the customer refuses the package, the order is returned to Dandes Electronics. For prepaid orders, a full refund is issued once the package reaches the warehouse. Cash on Delivery orders are simply cancelled.', '[OG-002] How to change the delivery address
The delivery address can be changed from the Orders page only before the order is shipped. After shipping, the address cannot be changed by Dandes Electronics or by the support team. The customer has two options: ask the courier to reschedule delivery to the same address, or refuse the delivery and place a new order with the correct address. Refusal refunds follow policy SH-005.', '[OG-005] How to report a damaged, defective or wrong item
To report a damaged, defective or wrong item, the customer opens the order on the Orders page and selects Report a Problem within 48 hours of delivery. The customer uploads photos of the product, the box and the shipping label, and an unboxing video if available. A pickup is scheduled within 2 business days. After the quality check, a replacement or refund is processed as per policies RR-003 and RR-005.', '[RR-003] Damaged or defective products
If a product arrives damaged or defective, the customer must report it within 48 hours of delivery using the Report a Problem option on the Orders page. Photos of the product and box, and an unboxing video if available, are required. After a pickup and quality check, the customer can choose a replacement or a full refund. For mobile phones, a refund is given only if a replacement unit is not available.']
response: The order can’t be cancelled after shipping. The customer can refuse delivery; the prepaid order is fully refunded once the package reaches the warehouse.
